purpose: Test whether structural discovery survives removal of target-aware metadata and semantics-preserving representation randomization, without promoting any result to solver, carrier, tractability, or P-vs-NP authority.

observer_effect_translation.measurement: any field exposed to discovery before candidate freeze
observer_effect_translation.delayed_reveal: provenance and historical labels disclosed only after candidate hash freeze
observer_effect_translation.important_note: These are classical experimental-design analogies, not quantum claims about the algorithm.

protocol: Freeze raw object SHA and transform seeds before discovery.
Expose only blind-mask-allowed fields to the discovery component.
Run discovery independently on every view.
Inverse-map each candidate to canonical coordinates.
Freeze candidate serialization and SHA before revealing provenance or historical labels.
Reveal provenance only after the freeze.
Run an independent exact checker on candidate semantics and replay obligations.
Treat all current-corpus executions as calibration only; no new evidence claim is licensed.
promotion_rule: No outcome from the exhausted v3.23 corpus can promote generality, universality, tractability, solver authority, or carrier authority. Future new source-bound raw provenance must be frozen under the then-current authority before this diagnostic can accompany an admissible scientific gate.
falsification_priority: Prefer discovering leakage or representation dependence over obtaining a PASS.
